description: Métropole - Localisation des SMUR héliportés (service WFS) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.atlasante.fr. WFS service - Geolocation of sites with helicopters capable of carrying out health emergencies according to their classification (SAMU, Gendarmerie, Air Force, National Navy, Civil Security). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Metropolis - Location of heliported SMURs (WFS service)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include smur héliporté, hélismur, smur, hélicoptères, smur héliportés, sécurité civile. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
